name: cache-guard
description: Counts down to prompt-cache expiry and, just before it, keeps the cache warm with a ping or compacts the conversation, so a long context is not re-written at full price.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: watch = only count down; ping = keep the cache warm with tiny forked questions; compact = compact just before expiry; ping+compact = pings first, then compact. The band and the settings panel override this.

ttl.title: Cache TTL
ttl.description: auto = learn it from the session and only count down until then; 5m or 1h = set by hand

maxPings.title: Pings before compact
maxPings.description: Keep-alive pings in one pause, 11 or more for no limit; ping+compact compacts after the last one

marginSeconds.title: Act before expiry (seconds)
marginSeconds.description: How long before the cache expires the ping or compact runs

minTokens.title: Minimum context (tokens)
minTokens.description: Below this the mod only watches

toolPings.title: Keep warm during long tools
toolPings.description: Ping while a tool in the main loop outlasts the cache, as long as that stays cheaper than re-caching

profile.title: Compact instruction profile
profile.description: Which text below a compaction is given

instructionsCode.title: Instructions: code
instructionsCode.description: General profile for coding work; the settings panel can edit it over this text
instructionsCode.default: Keep it tight: pointers over content. Preserve: user's corrections/preferences/limits quoted verbatim; decisions + why; approaches ruled out (1 line each); exact paths, symbols, commands, failing test names, error text; uncommitted/unverified changes; todo state; exact next step. Drop: tool output, code already on disk, resolved debugging detail.

instructionsDebug.title: Instructions: debug
instructionsDebug.description: For debugging sessions; the settings panel can edit it over this text
instructionsDebug.default: Debug focus: symptom + exact repro command; current hypothesis and its evidence; hypotheses ruled out + why (1 line each); exact error text, failing tests, file:line; temporary instrumentation to revert. Drop raw logs and resolved branches.

instructionsPlan.title: Instructions: plan
instructionsPlan.description: For planning and design sessions; the settings panel can edit it over this text
instructionsPlan.default: Design focus: goal, constraints and user's preferences verbatim; options considered: chosen + why, rejected + why; open questions for the user; agreed plan steps and status. No code snippets or file contents; reference paths only.
